cases.name: Olivia Marie Greenlee
cases.about: She was a senior at Union University majoring in music education and was a member of the Union University Singers.
cases.narrative: Police say Pittman shot Greenlee in the head while sitting in her car in the parking lot. He walked away and began to text and call her phone as if to hide that he had just been with her.
